title: fix(ui): long tool activity summaries run past the reply text in Safari and Firefox
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a long tool activity summary ("Ran commands, read files, called …") runs past the right edge of the reply text in Safari and Firefox, and continues under the Details panel, instead of stopping where the text column ends.

## User Impact

User impact: the collapsed tool summary now ends where the reply text ends, and shows an ellipsis when it is too long, in every browser.

In 1:1 threads at the default width, tool rows and the activity block are 8 px wider than before, so they end at the reply's edge instead of just short of it. Shared threads and saved chat widths keep their current widths.

## Why This Change Was Made

The summary limits its width to a percentage of the grid track it sits in, and that track had no size of its own. WebKit and Firefox size such a track to the unwrapped summary, so the limit followed the text instead of the column. Chromium kept the summary in the column but cut it mid-word. The group now has a track as wide as the reading column, and every summary label gets the ellipsis that only the live headline had.

Tool rows and the activity block also carried a 760 px cap from before the conversation column became 768 px wide. They now take the column's width, as they already did under a saved chat width.

## Evidence

Shared thread with the Details panel open, in WebKit (Playwright build 2370, Safari 27.2), 1317×560 at 2×, dark theme. Before is `main` at d29fad4e3e6; after is this change at 285aed1f2d0, which the PR head carries unchanged on current `main` (same patch ID; `main` did not touch `ui/` in between). The session is a mocked-Gateway fixture rendered by the real Control UI build, and the turn's folded activity was opened with a click.

### Clean comparison

**Before**

![Before: the tool summary continues past the right edge of the reply text and is cut mid-word](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7543bcad-9ade-4a57-83a6-bed2d68a4c81)

**After**

![After: the tool summary ends at the reply's right edge with an ellipsis](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/05d80827-2386-412b-8b72-e01f0c890b22)

### Annotated comparison

**Before**

![Before, annotated: an arrow marks the summary text beyond the reply's right edge](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e3a8eb5-d7ae-4ee6-9c54-fc11f2572993)

**After**

![After, annotated: a guide through the right edges of the summary and the reply shows 0 px between them](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/13dcf35f-ad81-4acd-a26f-bb2ee8eb589d)

Measured in the same captures:

|        | Summary                         | Reply paragraph | Summary label                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Before | 1484 px wide in a 668 px column | 668 px          | `text-overflow: clip`, never truncated   |
| After  | 668 px                          | 668 px          | `text-overflow: ellipsis`, truncated     |

- **Regression test:** `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-activity-summary-width.browser.test.tsx` covers direct and shared threads with framed and standalone activity. On `main` it fails in Chromium (`expected 'clip' to be 'ellipsis'`) and in WebKit (`expected 1358 to be greater than 1358`: the label is never truncated). On this branch all 4 cases pass in both, in 1.1 s (Chromium) and 1.5 s (WebKit) of wall time. The file joins the WebKit lane's list so CI runs it there.
- **Changed expectation:** `chat-responsive.browser.test.ts` asserted the 760 px default for tool rows and the activity block. It now asserts that they match the thread at the default width, as it already did for a saved width.
- **Sibling suites:** the chat column, activity layout, responsive and disclosure browser suites pass with the new file (82 tests in five files), and so do the tool-outcome, canvas detail width, bubble activity and heartbeat rollup E2E suites (25 tests).
- **Checks:** `pnpm check:changed` passes with the dead-export scan skipped (no exports changed; CI runs it): guards, format, type checks for the UI and core test graphs, lint and stylelint.
- **CI:** run [43992829096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43992829096) on this head has two failed jobs, both outside this change. `checks-ui (1/3)` fails `chat-transcript-projection-scale.test.ts` › "moves live activity to the current eligible group after replacement and run changes" with the same assertion as `main`'s scheduled run [43979180619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43979180619); it passes locally on this change three times. `checks-ui-e2e (6/10)` times out selecting a layout menu item in `chat-panel-layout.e2e.test.ts` › "preserves live content and saved geometry across main, dock, focus, and narrow layouts"; locally the same timeout occurs with `main`'s chat CSS in 3 of 4 runs and with this change in 1 of 4. This PR touches neither test nor their helpers. The WebKit lane, which runs the new test, passed (76 files).
- **Local review:** autoreview (Codex engine), branch mode from `origin/main` (d29fad4e3e6) to 285aed1f2d0 (the same patch as the PR head), priorities P0–P3: `scoped-clean`, no findings.

Gaps: Firefox was measured on a reduced page with the same grid and flex rules (summary 1585 px in a 668 px column with the auto track, 668 px with the column track), not in the product. In the fixture the transcript row clips the overflow 50 px past the reply; in the reported live session the same line continued under the Details panel.

Contributor: @Patrick-Erichsen reported the problem and requested the fix.
